items.title: Baseline 0daynews.com homepage CTA and content-path usability
items.summary: A site-specific page-level baseline is not present in the authoritative snapshot, so no non-duplicative implementation can be safely selected without inspecting the existing homepage and navigation evidence.

Record heading hierarchy, primary CTA or first-click path, navigation destinations, disclosure placement, mobile/accessibility defects, metadata, and the exact source files controlling the surface. Do not request duplicate telemetry, add tracking, change production, or claim lift.
